# Idea: Dodge the Falling Blocks

- Control a small square with the left/right arrow keys.
- Blocks of various sizes fall from the top at increasing speed.
- Survive as long as possible.
- **Lose condition:** any block collides with the player's square.
- Simple graphics can be implemented entirely with the HTML canvas, no external assets required.

12:   function beep(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.1) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = type;
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   const resumeAudio = () => audioCtx.resume();
25:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, { once: true });
26:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
27: 
28:   const player = { x: width / 2 - 15, y: height - 30, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 5 };
29:   const blocks = [];
30:   const particles = [];
31:   const keys = {};
32:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
33:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
34: 
35:   let lastSpawn = 0;
36:   let spawnInterval = 1500;
37:   let lastTime = 0;
38:   let gameOver = false;
39:   const startTime = performance.now();
40: 
41:   function spawnBlock() {

43:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
44:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3 + (performance.now() - startTime) / 20000;
45:     blocks.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed });
46:     // particle burst
47:     for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
48:       const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
49:       const speedP = Math.random() * 1 + 0.5;
50:       particles.push({
51:         x: x + size / 2,
52:         y: -size / 2,
53:         vx: Math.cos(angle) * speedP,
54:         vy: Math.sin(angle) * speedP,
55:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
56:         alpha: 0.8,
57:         decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02,
58:       });
59:     }
60:     beep(300, 'sine', 0.1);
61:   }
62: 
63:   function update(dt) {
64:     // player movement
65:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.x -= player.speed;
66:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.x += player.speed;
67:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
68: 
69:     // blocks movement
70:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const b = blocks[i];
72:       b.y += b.speed;
73:       if (b.y > height) blocks.splice(i, 1);
74:     }
75: 
76:     // particles update
77:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const p = particles[i];
79:       p.x += p.vx;
80:       p.y += p.vy;

82:       p.alpha -= p.decay;
83:       if (p.alpha <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
84:     }
85: 
86:     // collision
87:     for (const b of blocks) {
88:       if (b.x < player.x + player.w &&
89:           b.x + b.w > player.x &&
90:           b.y < player.y + player.h &&
91:           b.y + b.h > player.y) {
92:         gameOver = true;

94:         break;
95:       }
96:     }
97:   }
98:

102:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e0f7ff');

114:     ctx.fill();
115: 
116:     // blocks with gradient
117:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
118:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
119:     for (const b of blocks) {
120:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x, b.y + b.h);
121:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
122:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c81d25');
123:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
124:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
125:     }
126: 
127:     // particles
128:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
129:     for (const p of particles) {
130:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,0,${p.alpha})`;
131:       ctx.beginPath();
132:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
133:       ctx.fill();
134:     }
135: 
136:     // timer
137:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
138:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
139:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
140:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
141: 
142:     if (gameOver) {
143:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
144:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
145:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
146:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
147:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
148:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
149:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
150:       ctx.fillText(`Survived: ${elapsed}s`, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   function loop(timestamp) {
155:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
156:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
157:     lastTime = timestamp;
158: 
159:     if (!gameOver) {
160:       if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
161:         spawnBlock();
162:         lastSpawn = timestamp;
163:         spawnInterval = Math.max(300, spawnInterval - 10);
164:       }
165:       update(dt);
166:     }
167:     draw();
168:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169:   }
170: 
171:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
